svg.text: P2000 CP/M address decode & memory shuffle
Derived from MW106 pages 3 and 16 · modern KiCad schematic review
Direct binary order: one EEPROM byte per 2 KiB CPU window
2 U6 expansion-board shuffle in CP/M mode
Current D2→/CS selects A000–DFFF and removes /VIDS; 4000–7FFF remains a gap
✓ D7 mode latch matches boot ROM: LD A,80h / OUT (20h),A
✗ SRAM /CS diverts D2 (/VIDS), not the 7D decode gap
✗ SRAM /CS lacks /MREQ; matching I/O writes can write SRAM
! Manual byte 3E is F5 (/ROMS1), although its prose says /VIDS
